7573.title: Pi child exit leaves the next turn on a closed session
7573.rootCauseOneLine: The Pi bridge retains a closed child session and reuses it for unchanged turn options instead of rebuilding it.
7573.proposedFix: Restore a closed Pi session through the existing replacement path before submitting the next turn, preserving its provider-thread identity.
7573.caveats: Reproduced twice at the production bridge boundary with the trusted fake child; actual project extension loading and live UI/CLI not exercised.
